abbreviations.definition: A double-blind study is one in which neither the participant nor any of the investigator or sponsor staff who are involved in the treatment or clinical evaluation of the subjects are aware of the treatment received.

A complaint is any written, electronic, or oral communication that alleges deficiencies related to the identity, quality, purity, durability, reliability, safety or effectiveness, or performance of a drug or drug delivery system.
Adherence to all study-related, good clinical practice, and applicable regulatory requirements

A data monitoring committee is a group of independent scientists who are appointed to monitor the safety and scientific integrity of a human research intervention and to make recommendations to the sponsor regarding the stopping of a study for efficacy, or for harms, or for futility. The composition of the committee is dependent upon the scientific skills and knowledge required for monitoring the particular study.
The act of assigning a participant to a treatment. Participants who are enrolled in the study are those who have been assigned to a treatment.

A process by which a participant voluntarily confirms his or her willingness to participate in a particular study, after having been informed of all aspects of the study that are relevant to the participant’s decision to participate. Informed consent is documented by means of a written, signed, and dated informed consent form.
An interim analysis is an analysis of clinical study data, separated into treatment groups, that is conducted before the final reporting database is created/locked.

A pharmaceutical form of an active ingredient or placebo being tested or used as a reference in a clinical trial, including products already on the market when used or assembled (formulated or packaged) in a way different from the authorized form, or marketed products used for an unauthorized indication, or marketed products used to gain further information about the authorized form.
Equivalent to CDISC term “subject”: an individual who participates in a clinical trial, either as recipient of an investigational medicinal product or as a control
The act of determining if an individual meets minimum requirements to become part of a pool of potential candidates for participation in a clinical study.

Treatment-emergent adverse event: An untoward medical occurrence that emerges during a defined treatment period, having been absent pretreatment, or worsens relative to the pretreatment state, and does not necessarily have to have a causal relationship with this treatment.

notes: Sub-study of a master protocol. First page (p1), verbatim: "This study H0P-MC-BP02 (NCT05086289) is a sub-study of Master Protocol H0P-MC-CPMP (NCT05986292)". This document is the intervention-specific appendix (ISA) H0P-MC-BP02 to Master Protocol H0P-MC-CPMP (CPMP) and the CLBP disease-state appendix (DSA) H0P-MC-CPMP(2) (p2, p13); nothing was filled from the master. Deferrals to the master (as printed): SoA header (p11) 'Please refer to the CPMP Master Protocol and the CLBP DSA H0P-MC-CPMP(2) SoAs for additional information'; Appendix 1 (p29) 'The CPMP Master Protocol describes tests that may be performed at additional times noted in the SoA for this ISA. This table describes tests unique for ISA BP02.' - so the composition of SoA activities Hematology, Chemistry, Lipid panel, Urinalysis and HbA1c (and the specimen/lab of every lab activity) is not given in this document and is deferred to the master; objectives/endpoints (p8, p18), eligibility (p21), preparation/handling/storage (p22), concomitant therapy (p23), discontinuation (p24), AEs/SAEs (p25), statistics/populations (p27) are deferred to CPMP/CPMP(2). Section 8.2.3 (p25) refers to Section 10.1 (Appendix 1) for the clinical laboratory tests. Rule 10: the Appendix 1 lab-tests table (p29) was checked on the page image: one column 'Other Tests' with two rows (LY3526318 concentration; Urine pregnancy), followed by a CCI-redacted block; the image confirmed the text layer, no reassignment. p12 was viewed as an image: an SoA row between 'PK sample' and 'Participant Device' is CCI-redacted, and the first entry of the SoA abbreviation line is CCI-redacted - so 'dBM' (SoA note for 'Participant returns device') is not defined anywhere readable in the document. Many pages (e.g. 2, 7-9, 12-16, 19-23, 26-29, 34-36, 38) have a letter-spaced text layer; evidence quotes and the three SoA-table abbreviations from p12 (ED = early discontinuation; HbA1c = hemoglobin A1c; V = Visit) are kept exactly as the text layer spells them so the checker can verify them; target_heading and what_it_says give the readable wording. Instruments: none of this ISA's SoA activities is an instrument, so the list is empty; the Numeric Rating Scale (NRS) diary is mentioned (p19 'NRS diary entries', abbreviation p41) but has no SoA activity in this ISA (it belongs to the master/DSA SoAs). Panels: the only panel in this document is Appendix 1 'Other Tests'; no hematology/chemistry/lipid/urinalysis composition, specimen or central/local lab is stated. Labs: central vs local lab is not stated for any activity; Appendix 4 (p38) allows that 'Local laboratory testing may be conducted in lieu of central laboratory testing' only in exceptional circumstances. Pregnancy test conflict (rule 5): the SoA and Appendix 1 give a urine pregnancy test (p11, p29), while Appendix 2 (p31) states for WOCBP 'Negative urine result at screening followed by a negative serum result within 24 hours prior to treatment exposure. Note: Subsequent pregnancy testing is compound specific.' - both recorded under Urine pregnancy. Intervention compliance (SoA activity) is described in Section 6.4 (p22: direct questioning, counting returned capsules) - not one of the six categories, so not recorded as an item. QTcF (p25) is not in the abbreviation list (only QTc). Rule 11: the PDF holds one version only, Amendment (a) approved 10-Aug-2021 (original protocol 23-Jun-2021 summarised in the change table p4-5, which changes no SoA activity); extraction is from Amendment (a). Pages 15, 34-36 and parts of many pages are CCI-redacted; page 44 is the e-signature page. Updated 2026-11-07 to schema 1.1 (no re-extraction): instruments carry kind; letter-spaced abbreviation terms and definitions re-spaced (whitespace only, checked from page images).
